editorial.description: Choe uses a drawing requested by his daughter to ask how optimism survives chaos, drawing on *Forrest Gump*, improvisation, Larry David and a deliberately opinionated Star Wars viewing order before placing his own screen history in context.
editorial.summary: Choe uses a drawing requested by his daughter to ask how optimism survives chaos, drawing on *Forrest Gump*, improvisation, Larry David and a deliberately opinionated Star Wars viewing order before placing his own screen history in context. This is an official-channel creative lesson or reflection, not clinical treatment or a universal formula. Its chronological map follows the route's own transcript and distinguishes art-making instructions from autobiographical claims, jokes and metaphors. Visually dependent technique still requires the source video.
